Hi Lena — thanks for sending over the forms and for the clear list. Welcome aboard! Quick answers and next steps below.

Summary answers:
- PO approach: We can accept either a single standing PO for the quarter or month-by-month POs. If you send one standing PO, please reference the SOW/Account number on each invoice.
- Invoice cutoff: Invoices received by 5:00 PM PT on the invoice date are included in that day's ingest. For month close, invoices uploaded/submitted by the last business day are batched for the next monthly cycle.
- Net terms: Our default is Net30, but we can accommodate Net45 for customers with procurement requirements. Ill loop in Marissa to confirm any commercial or billing impacts.
- Early-pay: We do have an early-pay program (discount tiers depending on days-to-pay and payment method). Enrollment requires ACH and an enrollment form. Ive attached our Vendor_FAQ and PO_Routing_Instructions for your ops team.

Action items Ill own:
1) Marissa — can you confirm whether Net45 needs a contract amendment for this account and the available early-pay discount levels?
2) Karthik — please confirm our PO acknowledgement SLA and whether we need additional fields on Twine's PO for automated routing.
3) Lena — once Marissa confirms economics Ill send the early-pay enrollment link and the AP wiring/ACH instructions.

Hi all — finance here, quick clarification on the items Rachel flagged.

1) Net terms: We can book Twine on Net45 without changing pricing, provided the PO is on file and Twine enrolls in electronic payments (ACH) for payment execution. For customers who opt into early-pay we typically require ACH enrollment separately.

2) Early-pay program: We offer the following standard tiers (see attached term sheet):
   - Pay within 10 days: 1.25% discount off invoiced services
   - Pay within 15 days: 0.75% discount
   - Pay within 30 days: 0.5% discount
Note: Discounts apply to the invoice subtotal (services) and not to tax or third-party pass-through fees. Enrollment takes 2–3 business days after the ACH verification completes.

3) Invoice & PO rules:
   - Invoices should reference the Redwood SOW/Account number and the PO number in the invoice header for automated routing.
   - AP receives invoices at ap@redwood.ai.
   - PO acknowledgement SLA: our procurement ops team acknowledges POs within 24 business hours. Karthik: please confirm if we can auto-ack when PO fields are populated correctly.

4) Cutoff/close: Invoices submitted by 5:00 PM PT on the last business day are included in the monthly run; for mid-month billing we process on the following business day.

Attached: earlypay-program-term-sheet.pdf

If Twine confirms which early-pay tier they want, well send the ACH enrollment form and enrollment link (DocuSign).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Hi team — procurement ops here. Confirming our PO ack SLA and a few practical items for Twine's AP team: 

- PO acknowledgement: We will send an acknowledgement email within 24 business hours after receiving a valid PO. Valid = PO number + billing address + line items or reference to standing PO.
- Preferred PO field: please include the Redwood account name and SOW# in the PO 'Description' field so invoices auto-map.
- Standing PO: if Twine prefers a single standing PO, please put the start and end dates on the PO and indicate 'standing/quarterly' in the type field.

Happy to take a quick call if Twine wants to walk through the sample PO mapping.

Thanks,
